nodes.description: Verify current authority, contracts, roots, state, exclusions, and next obligation.
Freeze object, statement, assumptions, counterexample interface, budgets, and success conditions.
Hash exact inputs, source boundaries, toolchains, contracts, and inherited heads.
Run exact deterministic finite computation with captured input and output roots.
Compile an exact Lean module through its pinned Lake environment.
Compile a theorem with no sorry/admit/axiom escape in the declared proof boundary.
Verify a bounded deductive claim with an exact UCM native proof contract.
Challenge assumptions, boundaries, omissions, degenerate fixtures, and bypasses.
Demonstrate that a check detects the defect it names.
Verify and replay an exact package without altering frozen predecessors.
Run qualification from a clean extraction or clone with independently pinned outer identity.
Verify chains, identities, read-set closure, terminal custody, correspondence, and remainder.
Prevent evidence from supporting a stronger claim than its method and scope.
A caller may qualify repository content with the repository's own clean-checkout verifier; there is no generic projection adapter.
Historical capability identity retained for lineage; portable harness ships no commit adapter or inherited commit authority.
Historical capability identity retained for lineage; portable harness ships no remote-write adapter or inherited push authority.

known_gaps: UCM native proof adapter is not yet source-bound to a CBMD theorem contract.
Each initialized workspace starts without mathematical-adapter mutation receipts; harness adverse tests do not qualify mathematics.
Artifact-specific Lean replay is supplied separately by this research repository; a generic package-replay and repository-projection adapter is not implemented by the harness.
No harness self-check counts as independent verification.
